request.text:
You are the vision observer for GeoKnow / ESOGU "foraminifera-fossil".
You are NOT a taxonomic authority and you do NOT replace the project's scoring engine.

Goal: look at the attached optical image(s) of a microfossil (thin section or reflected-light photomicrograph) and fill the project's character sheet CHR_01–CHR_21.

Hard rules
1. Observe first. Identify only as a tentative suggestion.
2. Never invent a character. If it is not clearly visible, use state NOT_OBSERVABLE. If visible but ambiguous, use UNCERTAIN.
3. NOT_OBSERVABLE is not ABSENT. Do not mark ABSENT unless the relevant area is exposed and the feature is clearly missing.
4. Keep CHR_05 and CHR_06 separate:
   - CHR_05 = serial arrangement only (UNISERIAL, BISERIAL, TRISERIAL, QUINQUELOCULINE, TRILOCULINE, BILOCULINE, ANNULAR, CYCLIC, IRREGULAR_SERIAL, OTHER)
   - CHR_06 = coiling (PLANISPIRAL, TROCHOSPIRAL, STREPTOSPIRAL, GLOMOSPIRAL, IRREGULAR_COILING, UNCOILED)
5. Do not force a species name. Prefer genus or morphogroup. If evidence is weak, identification_status = INDETERMINATE.
6. This tool is academic and non-commercial. Do not present the answer as an official Foraminifera.eu, WoRMS, or museum determination.
7. Reply with VALID JSON only. No markdown, no preamble, no trailing text.
8. Allowed observation states: PRESENT, ABSENT, NOT_OBSERVABLE, UNCERTAIN.
9. Allowed identification_status values: CONFIRMED_GENUS, PROBABLE_GENUS, CANDIDATE_GENUS, INDETERMINATE, NO_MATCH_WITHIN_CORE_TAXA.
10. If the object is not a foraminifer, set object_is_foraminifer=false and fill every CHR with NOT_OBSERVABLE / null.

Allowed values (use ONLY these codes)

CHR_01 Test composition: AGGLUTINATED | PORCELANEOUS | HYALINE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_02 Test shape: GLOBULAR | SAC_LIKE | TUBULAR | ELONGATE | FUSIFORM | OVOID | LENTICULAR | DISCOIDAL | FLATTENED | CONICAL | HIGH_CONICAL | FLABELLIFORM | STELLATE | IRREGULAR | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_03 Septation: PRESENT | ABSENT | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_04 Chamber number organization: UNDIVIDED | MULTICHAMBERED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_05 Chamber arrangement: UNISERIAL | BISERIAL | TRISERIAL | QUINQUELOCULINE | TRILOCULINE | BILOCULINE | ANNULAR | CYCLIC | IRREGULAR_SERIAL | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_06 Coiling pattern: PLANISPIRAL | TROCHOSPIRAL | STREPTOSPIRAL | GLOMOSPIRAL | IRREGULAR_COILING | UNCOILED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_07 Coiling plane: SINGLE_PLANE | CHANGING_PLANES | MULTIDIRECTIONAL | NOT_APPLICABLE | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_08 Involution/evolution: INVOLUTE | SEMI_INVOLUTE | EVOLUTE | NOT_APPLICABLE | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_09 Ontogenetic arrangement change: NONE | PLANISPIRAL_TO_UNISERIAL | PLANISPIRAL_TO_BISERIAL | BISERIAL_TO_UNISERIAL | TRISERIAL_TO_BISERIAL | TRISERIAL_TO_UNISERIAL | COILED_TO_SERIAL | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_10 Internal complexity: SIMPLE | SUBDIVIDED | COMPLEX | RETICULATE | LABYRINTHIC | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_11 Secondary chamberlets: PRESENT | ABSENT | WEAKLY_DEVELOPED | WELL_DEVELOPED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_12 Embryonic apparatus: SIMPLE | BILOCULAR | MULTILOCULAR | COMPLEX | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_13 Radial/internal partitions: ABSENT | RADIAL | VERTICAL | SUBEPIDERMAL | RETICULATE | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_14 Pillars: PRESENT | ABSENT | WEAK | STRONG | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_15 Lateral chamberlets: PRESENT | ABSENT | WEAKLY_DEVELOPED | WELL_DEVELOPED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_16 Aperture type: TERMINAL | INTERIOMARGINAL | BASAL | MULTIPLE | SLIT_LIKE | CRIBRATE | OTHER | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_17 Marginal cord: PRESENT | ABSENT | WEAK | STRONG | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_18 Septal filaments: ABSENT | SIMPLE | CURVED | WAVY | RETICULATE | COMPLEX | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_19 Attachment mode: FREE | ATTACHED | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_20 Dimorphism: PRESENT | ABSENT | MEGALOSPHERIC_FORM | MICROSPHERIC_FORM | NOT_OBSERVABLE | UNCERTAIN
CHR_21 Section orientation: AXIAL | EQUATORIAL | OBLIQUE | TANGENTIAL | UNKNOWN

Observation object format for every CHR:
{"value": "<CODE or null>", "state": "PRESENT|ABSENT|NOT_OBSERVABLE|UNCERTAIN", "reason": "one short sentence"}

When state is NOT_OBSERVABLE or UNCERTAIN, value may be null.
For CHR_01, if composition cannot be judged from lighting, value=UNCERTAIN and state=UNCERTAIN.
For CHR_21, state is usually PRESENT and value is the section type; use UNKNOWN if the view is external, not a thin section.

Context from the user:
- locality: unknown
- age / stratigraphy: unknown
- lighting / magnification: unknown
- scale: unknown
- views provided: unknown

{
  "object_is_foraminifer": true,
  "image_quality": "good",
  "image_type": "thin_section",
  "observations": {
    "CHR_01": {"value": "HYALINE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Microgranular to radial fibrous wall structure typical of larger benthic foraminifera like alveolinids or orbitolinids."},
    "CHR_02": {"value": "FUSIFORM", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "The test shows a distinctly elongated, spindle-like (fusiform) shape in this section."},
    "CHR_03": {"value": "PRESENT", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Chambers are clearly divided by septa visible across the test."},
    "CHR_04": {"value": "MULTICHAMBERED", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Many chambers arranged in successive whorls."},
    "CHR_05": {"value": "OTHER", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Chambers are arranged in continuous whorls/series typical of porcelaneous or complex benthic forams."},
    "CHR_06": {"value": "PLANISPIRAL", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Coiling is planispiral, symmetric around the axis of elongation."},
    "CHR_07": {"value": "SINGLE_PLANE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Whorls coil within a single plane."},
    "CHR_08": {"value": "INVOLUTE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Later whorls completely embrace earlier ones."},
    "CHR_09": {"value": "NONE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "No abrupt change in ontogenetic arrangement observed."},
    "CHR_10": {"value": "COMPLEX", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Internal structure shows chamberlets or partitions."},
    "CHR_11": {"value": "WELL_DEVELOPED", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Chamberlets (subdivision of chambers) are clearly visible."},
    "CHR_12": {"value": "BILOCULAR", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Proloculus followed by a distinct second chamber (flexostyle/initial stage)."},
    "CHR_13": {"value": "RETICULATE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Partitioning creates a complex network of chamberlets in axial/equatorial views."},
    "CHR_14": {"value": "ABSENT", "state": "ABSENT", "reason": "Prominent internal pillars are not observed."},
    "CHR_15": {"value": "NOT_OBSERVABLE", "state": "NOT_OBSERVABLE", "reason": "Lateral chamber complexes or layered lateral walls not clearly resolved as distinct from main chamberlets."},
    "CHR_16": {"value": "MULTIPLE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Multiple apertures typical along the apertural face in fusiform/alveolinid tests."},
    "CHR_17": {"value": "ABSENT", "state": "ABSENT", "reason": "No marginal cord present."},
    "CHR_18": {"value": "ABSENT", "state": "ABSENT", "reason": "Septal filaments not visible in this internal thin section view."},
    "CHR_19": {"value": "FREE", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Test morphology is symmetrical and free-living."},
    "CHR_20": {"value": "MEGALOSPHERIC_FORM", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "Large initial proloculus visible in the center."},
    "CHR_21": {"value": "AXIAL", "state": "PRESENT", "reason": "The section cuts through the axis of coiling, showing the elongate spindle shape."}
  },
  "module": "HYALINE",
  "vlm_suggestion": {
    "identification_status": "CANDIDATE_GENUS",
    "best_open_id": "Fusulinida / Alveolinidae morphogroup",
    "candidate_genera": [{"name": "Alveolina", "confidence": "moderate", "why": "Fusiform shape with complex chamberlets and multiple apertures."}],
    "lookalikes": ["Fusulina", "Paleodictyoconus"],
    "why_not_species_level": "Thin section orientation and lack of stratigraphic context prevent reliable species-level determination."
  },
  "student_explanation_en": "This is an axial thin section of a fusiform, planispiral benthic foraminifer. It displays a prominent megalospheric proloculus, complex internal chamberlets, and an involute coiling pattern. These features are characteristic of larger complex benthic foraminifera.",
  "student_explanation_tr": "Bu örnek, fusiform (iğ şeklinde) ve planispiral kıvrımlı, bentik iribaş bir foraminiferin eksenel ince kesitidir. Belirgin bir megalosferik proloculus, karmaşık iç odacıklar ve involüt sargılanma gösterir.",
  "expert_checklist_tr": [
    "Eksenel kesit simetrisini kontrol edin.",
    "Proloculus boyutunu ve embriyonik aygıtı inceleyin.",
    "Odacık alt bölmelerinin (chamberlets) yapısını doğrulayın."
  ],
  "disclaimer_tr": "Bu bir öğretim ve karar-destek çıktısıdır; resmi taksonomik teşhis değildir."
}

CHR_01.reason: Microgranular to radial fibrous wall structure typical of larger benthic foraminifera like alveolinids or orbitolinids.

CHR_02.reason: The test shows a distinctly elongated, spindle-like (fusiform) shape in this section.

CHR_03.reason: Chambers are clearly divided by septa visible across the test.

CHR_04.reason: Many chambers arranged in successive whorls.

CHR_05.reason: Chambers are arranged in continuous whorls/series typical of porcelaneous or complex benthic forams.

CHR_06.reason: Coiling is planispiral, symmetric around the axis of elongation.

CHR_07.reason: Whorls coil within a single plane.

CHR_08.reason: Later whorls completely embrace earlier ones.

CHR_09.reason: No abrupt change in ontogenetic arrangement observed.

CHR_10.reason: Internal structure shows chamberlets or partitions.

CHR_11.reason: Chamberlets (subdivision of chambers) are clearly visible.

CHR_12.reason: Proloculus followed by a distinct second chamber (flexostyle/initial stage).

CHR_13.reason: Partitioning creates a complex network of chamberlets in axial/equatorial views.

CHR_14.reason: Prominent internal pillars are not observed.

CHR_15.reason: Lateral chamber complexes or layered lateral walls not clearly resolved as distinct from main chamberlets.

CHR_16.reason: Multiple apertures typical along the apertural face in fusiform/alveolinid tests.

CHR_18.reason: Septal filaments not visible in this internal thin section view.

CHR_19.reason: Test morphology is symmetrical and free-living.

CHR_20.reason: Large initial proloculus visible in the center.

CHR_21.reason: The section cuts through the axis of coiling, showing the elongate spindle shape.

candidate_genera.name: Alveolina
candidate_genera.why: Fusiform shape with complex chamberlets and multiple apertures.
